metadata.description: Measured code quality for existing codebases, stack-agnostic: a constraint engine that derives its scope from the constraints themselves, plus an onboarding layer that derives every rule from the project's own code.

plugins.name: quality-constraints
plugins.description: The constraint engine: file format (SPEC), matcher, format linter, measurement store, diff/directory verification for reviews, constraint editing and retrospective. Language-agnostic.

plugins.name: quality-onboard
plugins.description: The onboarding layer: analyzes an existing codebase, measures its conventions, writes the constraint files and generates the project's own scaffolding skills. Nothing generic ships with it: every rule, model and tool reference is derived from the project.
